title: Why this concept
detail: Combine repeat visits for drinks and small treats with larger gift orders. Reuse a few chocolate bases across products. Add complex experiences after paid demand is demonstrated. This is an editorial business recommendation, not a profitability forecast.

title: Starting assortment
detail: Use dark, milk and white couverture as the main bases. Offer 6 bonbon fillings, 4 bars or barks, 2 dipped snacks, 2 drinks and 1 shared dessert base. Treat box sizes as packaging options, not separate recipes.

title: Stocking brands
detail: Start with 8–12 outside brands across familiar, premium and craft tiers. Taste-test samples, confirm authorized supply and landed cost, then rotate slow sellers. The global directory is for selection, not a proposal to stock every entry.

title: 3D printing
detail: Pilot prepaid names, monograms, plaques and cake toppers. Start with flat, supported designs. Purchase equipment only after testing food-contact suitability, approved feedstock, cleaning time, print failures and actual capacity.

title: Scope and assumptions
detail: Prepared 08 Oct 2026. Location, budget and customer segment were not supplied. Priorities reflect a small independent shop. Ideas and brand lists are broad, not exhaustive. Recipes, shelf life, imports and local approvals require product-specific validation. Brand rows distinguish current source evidence from research candidates.

title: Definitions
detail: Core = first launch shortlist. Expand = add after demand. Test = limited pilot. Specialist = needs dedicated skill or controls. Priorities are editorial judgments. “Vegan”, “gluten-free”, “halal” and similar claims require ingredient, supplier and process evidence. No universal best chocolate brand exists across price, flavor and use.

title: Practical buying shortlist
detail: Ingredient trials: Callebaut, Cacao Barry, Valrhona and Guittard, subject to local trade availability. Familiar retail: Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury and Ritter Sport. Craft discovery: Tony’s Chocolonely, Auro, Marou, Menakao and Paccari. Select by tasting, product specification, supply consistency and landed contribution. These are starting candidates, not a ranked quality claim.
